messages:
Noah Rivera: Quick idea for webinar FAQ/Q&A flow: split into 2 segments — live 10m audience Q&A, then a 10m rapid-fire technical questions block for engineers. Thoughts?
Zoe Kim: Love that. Keeps product folks engaged and gives engineers deep-dive time.
Priya Desai: Agree. Need to communicate in the registration page so devs know to stay for the technical block. Can we add a checkbox for 'Ask a technical question'?
Theo Morgan: Also suggest collecting top 5 pre-submitted questions and surface them first in the live Q&A. Cuts down on repeat questions.
Noah Rivera: Good call. Zoe, can you update the registration copy with a dev checkbox and a blurb about the tech deep-dive?
Zoe Kim: On it. Draft: "Stay for a technical rapid-fire where our ML engineers answer architecture and latency questions. Check "I have a technical question" to submit ahead of time."
Priya Desai: For routing: post-webinar leads where checkbox checked -> sales-technical cohort in CRM; others -> general outbound. OpsBot, create tag rule.
OpsBot: Rule created: tag=webinar_apr26_tech_cohort condition=registration.checkbox. Notify=@sales @growth
Theo Morgan: Rehearsal note: reserve last 5 minutes of the tech block for live demo rollback explanation (failover policy, cost tradeoffs). Keep slides minimal.
Noah Rivera: Perfect. I'll add the pre-submission field to the registration form and share the updated run-of-show by EOD.
